primary_principle: Select and validate physical models using CAL-PHYS outcomes only; downstream routing performance is neither an input nor a model-selection criterion.

analysis_population.confirmatory: all scheduled independent units not excluded by a preregistered protocol or safety rule
analysis_population.diagnostic: excluded or deviating units retained with reason codes and analyzed separately without replacing confirmatory units after outcomes are known
analysis_population.repeated_measurement_structure: timestamps and sensors nested within run; samples and timestamps nested within product lot

data_processing.unit_conversions: declared in the source registry and implemented by a versioned deterministic transform

time_alignment.principle: use synchronized source clocks; freeze interpolation before holdout access

sensor_aggregation.principle: retain sensor-level data and report spatial dispersion

data_processing.outlier_policy: no residual- or effect-based deletion; sensor faults require independent instrument/protocol evidence and a deviation code
data_processing.missing_policy: no imputation of primary holdout responses unless an explicit method and maximum missingness threshold are frozen before collection

primary_v2_light.preconditioning: independently metered dispatch energy; excluded from in-route cooling and door-recovery double counting

fit_method.family: bounded nonlinear or state-space estimation with run-level clustering

thermal_models.weighting: measurement-uncertainty weighting may be used only from instrument accuracy/repeatability estimates fixed before holdout evaluation
identifiability_checks: profile likelihood or equivalent interval for every free parameter
multi-start convergence to materially equivalent solutions
recovery of known parameters on synthetic traces
thermal_models.nonidentifiable_action: DATA_INSUFFICIENT or preregistered v1-effective fallback; do not report separately unidentified parameters

quality_models.minimum_temperature_support: at least three in-domain isothermal temperatures per product
quality_models.repeated_measurement_model: respect samples/timestamps nested within product lot; lot is the independent unit
quality_models.reaction_order_decision: the first-order model may be accepted only if preregistered isothermal and variable-temperature diagnostics pass; otherwise return MODEL_INADEQUATE and version the state equation
quality_models.initial_quality_mapping: freeze a monotone product-specific conversion from the raw quality indicator to quality_fraction; preserve measured lot-level Q0 and do not force every observed lot to equal 1
quality_models.threshold_analysis: continuous quality prediction is primary; unsalable classification is secondary and uses an externally justified frozen threshold
quality_models.product_value_rule: business value is excluded from calibrated economic claims unless supported by independent auditable cost data

internal_calibration_diagnostics: residual versus time, temperature lift, load, door duration, and fitted value

confirmatory_holdout.access: one-shot after code, parameter bounds, model structure, transforms, and thresholds are frozen
confirmatory_holdout.quality_split_unit: entire unseen product lot and its full temperature history

uncertainty.method: cluster bootstrap or model-based interval chosen and frozen before confirmatory fit
uncertainty.gate_logic: intersection-union: every primary nominal endpoint and every invariant must pass; no multiplicity-adjusted composite or endpoint averaging may rescue a failure
uncertainty.interval_direction: freeze the direction per metric before confirmatory access; error and limit metrics use an upper confidence bound against the maximum acceptable value
uncertainty.simultaneous_claim_rule: If the paper claims simultaneous coverage of several intervals, freeze an appropriate simultaneous procedure; otherwise describe intervals as endpoint-specific and use them only within the all-endpoints-must-pass gate.

physical_invariants: zero duration with no event produces no state or energy change
electrical energy and thermal load are nonnegative
higher positive ambient-to-compartment lift cannot reduce passive heat ingress when other inputs are fixed
higher load cannot reduce effective thermal capacity when cargo capacity coefficient is nonnegative
longer door opening cannot reduce modeled door heat under positive lift
cooling capacity is not interpreted as electrical input power
preconditioning, passive heat, door heat, cooling thermal load, and electrical input are not double counted
quality cannot improve under the declared irreversible decay model
unit conversions close in an end-to-end trace

acceptance_thresholds.basis_required: instrument accuracy, repeatability pilot, product assay precision, and operational tolerance
acceptance_thresholds.pilot_firewall: P1 may quantify measurement capability and variance, but thresholds cannot be chosen to make a fitted physical model pass; all numerical thresholds and their derivations are frozen before P2-P6 confirmatory outcome access.
acceptance_thresholds.rule: all primary nominal holdout thresholds and all physical invariants must pass; averaging a failed response family into a composite score is forbidden

v1_effective_fallback.trigger: v2-light parameters are not identifiable with the frozen design, while a v1-effective model can be evaluated without accessing routing outcomes
requirements: effective parameters tied to a narrow stated operating domain
v1 passes the same applicable independent holdout thresholds
paper removes claims of separately identified load, door-duration, or energy-chain effects

sensitivity_contracts.construction_time: after nominal CAL-PHYS fit and before any calibrated DEV method comparison
sensitivity_contracts.low_stress: a jointly plausible preregistered operating scenario within evidence-supported ranges
sensitivity_contracts.high_stress: a jointly plausible preregistered operating scenario within evidence-supported ranges
sensitivity_contracts.forbidden_construction: independently combine all marginal parameter extremes or choose values that maximize/minimize a routing method gap

cal_phys_may_fit: product-specific quality kinetics and indicator conversion
objective_profile_separation.profile_freeze_stage: Step 15 new DEV-CAL after calibrated contract vNext is sealed

verdicts.GO_CAL_PHYS: all integrity, identifiability, invariant, and nominal holdout gates pass; freeze calibrated nominal and sensitivity contracts
verdicts.DATA_INSUFFICIENT: the frozen data do not identify required parameters or provide the planned independent-unit precision; collect new data under a versioned protocol before refitting
verdicts.MODEL_INADEQUATE: the declared equation shows systematic physical holdout failure; revise the model and preregister a new protocol version
verdicts.PROTOCOL_ERROR: firewall, split, identity, schedule, unit, exclusion, or holdout-access rules were violated; preserve evidence and invalidate the confirmatory verdict
verdicts.MEASUREMENT_FAILURE: instrument calibration, synchronization, chain of custody, or required-channel completeness prevents confirmatory use

reporting_requirements: complete parameter table with units, intervals, bounds, and provenance
independent-unit counts by condition and block
calibration and untouched holdout metrics separately
v2-light versus v1-effective decision with no routing outcomes
nominal, low-stress, and high-stress contract hashes
machine, environment, code, data, protocol, and analysis hashes
explicit limits on vehicle, operating domain, product, and quality indicator
freeze_rule: No confirmatory model fitting or holdout access is allowed while status is draft_blocked or pilot_registered, or while blocking_fields is nonempty; pilot_registered authorizes only the separately sealed P1 instrument pilot analysis.
